form.label: AD – Object Lifecycle
form.description: Creation, deletion, move, and undelete events for Active Directory Objects

input.label: 🔍 Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter by group name, admin, or domain controller

div.p: Object creation, deletion, move, and undelete events — detect drift in the AD inventory.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (4727, 4730, 4731, 4734, 4744, 4748, 4749, 4753, 4754, 4758, 4759, 4763, 5137, 5138, 5139, 5141) | search $search_filter$ | eval ObjectDN = coalesce(DN, TargetObject, ObjectName,New_DN)
| rex field=Message "(?i)Group Name\s*:\s*(?<GroupName>[^\r\n]+)" | eval Group_Name = coalesce(Group_Name, GroupName)
| eval AdminUser = SubjectUserName | eval Computer = ComputerName
| lookup cs_obj_change_eventcodes.csv EventCode OUTPUT signature as DefaultSignature
| eval Action = case( EventCode IN (4727, 4731, 4744, 4749, 4754, 4759, 5137), "Create", EventCode IN (4730, 4734, 4748, 4753, 4758, 4763, 5141), "Delete", EventCode=5138, "Undelete", EventCode=5139, "Move", 1=1, "Modify" )
| rex field=Message "(?i)New DN\s*:\s*(?<new_dn_obj>[^\r\n]+)"
| eval AdminUser=Subject_Account_Name | eval admin_logonID=Logon_ID | eval Changes = coalesce(DefaultSignature, "-") | rex field=Message "(?i)DN\s*:\s*(?<Target_Account_Name>[^\r\n]+)" | eval Final_Target=case(EventCode = 5139,"New DN: " . ObjectDN . " | Old DN: " . Target_Account_Name,EventCode IN (4727,4730,4731,4734,4744,4748,4749,4753,4754,4758,4759,4763),Group_Name,EventCode = 5138,new_dn_obj, 1=1 ,Target_Account_Name)
| table _time, Computer, AdminUser,Subject_Account_Domain,admin_logonID,Final_Target, Action, EventCode, signature | rename Final_Target as "Target Object" | sort - _time
